title: Steps 6 to 9 for object local and none: confirm, annotated tag, per-remote push, release object
objective: Build steps 6 to 9 of a cut for object local and none -- one confirmation naming everything other machines will see, an annotated tag at the release commit carrying the note's body, a push of only what each remote lacks, and the release object made or brought to this release's title and notes -- each reading its postcondition first, so a cut that stops anywhere resumes, and a tag is never moved.
